import subprocess

jar = Path('dist/lombok.jar').resolve()
for mode, private, final in [('private', True, False), ('final', False, True), ('both', True, True)]:

    (folder / 'Foo.java').write_text('public record Foo() {}\n')
    (folder / 'Bar.java').write_text('public record Bar(String value) { static int counter; public record Nested(int value) {} }\n')
    (folder / 'Fields.java').write_text('class Fields { int value = 0; }\n')
    subprocess.run(['javac', '-cp', str(jar), '-d', str(folder), str(folder / 'Foo.java'), str(folder / 'Bar.java'), str(folder / 'Fields.java')], check=True)
    fields = subprocess.check_output(['javap', '-private', '-classpath', str(folder), 'Fields'], text=True)
    value_line = next(line for line in fields.splitlines() if 'int value;' in line)
    assert ('private' in value_line) == private, (mode, fields)
    assert ('final' in value_line) == final, (mode, fields)
    bar = subprocess.check_output(['javap', '-private', '-classpath', str(folder), 'Bar'], text=True)
    assert 'static int counter;' in bar and 'private static int counter;' not in bar and 'static final int counter;' not in bar, (mode, bar)
    (folder / 'Explicit.java').write_text('@lombok.experimental.FieldDefaults(makeFinal = true) public record Explicit() {}\n')
    explicit = subprocess.run(['javac', '-cp', str(jar), '-d', str(folder), str(folder / 'Explicit.java')], capture_output=True, text=True)
    assert explicit.returncode != 0 and '@FieldDefaults is only supported on a class or an enum.' in explicit.stderr, (mode, explicit.stderr)
